summary: Test-writing phase for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI Swift client) completed; implementation criteria are deferred to the follow-up implementation run by phase rules. Committed: (a) OpenAPISpecConformanceTests — Foundation-only tests in the already-wired ColorMatchingLPSAppTests target that read the to-be-vendored iOS/Sources/ColorMatchingOpenAPI/openapi.json and fail while it is absent (red-phase evidence for the vendoring deliverable); (b) iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingOpenAPITests/ — stubbed-transport tests driving the future generated client over all six app surfaces, with a README pinning the Package.swift wiring contract; (c) docs/openapi-client-migration.md — acceptance-criterion verification plan plus the prose-contract-vs-published-spec deltas and endpoint gaps derived from viamin/color_matching main (issue #110 landed upstream; spec served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json). No Swift toolchain exists in this container (swift: command not found; the app executable target also requires SwiftUI/AVFoundation, so a Linux toolchain would not build the package), so no test executed locally; CI's macOS runner runs 'swift test' once the implementation run wires the new target. swift test --disable-sandbox is expected red at this head only because of the deliberately-missing vendored spec file.
